name: Booking Calendar
description: A booking starter: rooms and staff with weekly availability rules, a week calendar to book, move and cancel, a public booking flow that only offers free slots, overlap conflicts refused by the services, and bookings that complete or no-show as simulated time advances.

highlights: Week calendar with drag to move and click to book
Public booking flow with free slots only
Overlapping bookings refused by the services
Completed and no-show states as time advances
